title: light mexican cheese enchiladas
description: delicate, slow-cooked cheese wrapped in agave leaves, a comforting mexican delight. perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: carefully place 2 agave leaves on a flat surface, overlapping slightly.
lay a quarter cup of quesadilla cheese at the center of each leaf, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
roll the leaves to form tight cylinders, then place seam-side down in a baking dish.
dot the tops of the enchiladas with butter and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
remove foil and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until lightly browned.
let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
